text: きみの　とり　ポケモンは　きみを　のせて　そらを　とぶ　わざは　おぼえたかい？

structure.jp: きみの　とり　ポケモンは
きみを　のせて　そらを　とぶ　わざは
structure.en: the move that carries you and flies through the sky

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きみを　のせて　そらを　とぶ　わざ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. きみを のせて そらを とぶ わざ = 'the move that flies through the sky with you on its back'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a friendly, slightly manly way to ask a yes-or-no question instead of か. おぼえたかい = 'has it learned it?'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form here shows the two actions happening together: flying while carrying. きみを のせて = 'with you on its back'.
